config.name: Locked multi-year instrument extension and stronger spatial controls
config.scope: Designed after the original 2010-2025 OISST and 2026 OISST/AMSR2 outcomes were viewed. 2023-2025 AMSR2 targets have not been acquired or viewed. Existing EOF basis/seasonal field is retained; new parameters use 2010-2019 and hyperparameters only 2020-2021. Lock forecast bytes, model/source hashes and scoring rules publicly before acquiring these external targets. This is a pre-acquisition instrument extension conditional on prior exploration, not an untouched OISST test, latent-truth verification, mechanism identification or proof of global superiority. The primary family is three spatial models times three horizons on pooled nighttime 2023-2025 losses versus grid-specific anomaly persistence; Holm adjustment separately per block choice. Annual/seasonal and afternoon comparisons are descriptive. All scoring dates receive equal weight; no cell-level iid inference, bias correction or post-score tuning.

quality_rules.name: AMSR2 independent-instrument matched observation verification
quality_rules.product: RSS GCOM-W1 AMSR2 daily AS-ECV v8.2
quality_rules.quality_rule: finite SST in [-3,35] degrees Celsius; time in [0,24) hours UTC; land/coast/sea_ice/noobs masks all zero; exact common grid; fixed 2010 ocean mask
quality_rules.spatial_transfer: grid forecast = OISST grid observation at origin d-h + frozen regional forecast(d) - regional OISST observation at origin d-h; no fitted spatial coefficient; same transfer applied to frozen anomaly-persistence baseline; raw grid persistence also scored
quality_rules.score_weighting: cosine-latitude weighted loss across common observed cells within each target UTC day, then equal weight per day; no spatial pseudo-replication
quality_rules.scope: Independent instrument observations, not a fully statistically independent product: RSS v8.2 instrument drift characterization used Reynolds SST. Prior OISST 2026 scores already viewed; this external-observation protocol is frozen before viewing AMSR2 2026 targets. Retrospective forecasts with fixed spatial projection; evaluates observed offshore grid cells, not unobserved coast or full-domain means. No retuning, bias correction, or interval recalibration. Regional interval radii at grid cells are diagnostic only.
